title_zh: 暂停清理不明粉末并安排报告

scenario.label_zh: 暂停清理不明粉末并安排报告
scenario.goal_zh: 明确尚不清楚粉末是什么并约定暂停清理并联系受训人员

context_zh: 虚构工作间安全沟通练习。两名未受专业清理训练的员工发现不明粉末，只讨论停止操作与报告。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: There's powder beside that bottle. Shall I fetch the vacuum?

sentences.speaker: Idris
sentences.text: Wait. The bottle has a toxic warning, and we don't know what the powder is.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: You're right. I shouldn't wipe it up either before someone qualified has checked it.

sentences.speaker: Idris
sentences.text: Leave it alone. I'll contact the trained site staff and tell them exactly what we found.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: I'll stay back and let the others know not to start cleaning it.
